title: Activity
description: A step in a process: a task, or an event or gateway in its flow (BPMN's flow nodes).

domain.description: the business this belongs to (its map's domain slug)

description.description: what it is, in the business's words

kind.description: BPMN's element: task, userTask, serviceTask, manualTask, businessRuleTask, sendTask, receiveTask, scriptTask, startEvent, endEvent, intermediateCatchEvent, intermediateThrowEvent, exclusiveGateway, parallelGateway, inclusiveGateway, eventBasedGateway

bpmn_id.description: its id in the BPMN file it came from

shape.description: where BPMN's diagram draws it: {x, y, width, height} (BPMNDI)

outgoing.description: its sequence flows: [{to (an activity slug), id, name, condition, waypoints}]

data.description: its BPMN data associations: [{id, direction (in or out), document (a slug), waypoints}]

minutes.description: the time it is said to take, in minutes, if someone said

bpmn.description: what else BPMN 2.0 XML says of it: its event definitions, its default flow, the placeholder property its data inputs target
